purpose: KB 2026090003 PRE FROZEN RECONSTRUCTION V1, section 4: identify the real, legitimate PRE model path for CUT/TOP20/TOP10/TOP5/WIN and classify its provenance honestly -- never silently call a new model 'recovered'.

models_inspected.status_for_kb: Already run for KB -- content/website_v2/2026090003_PRE_WIN_FORECAST.json, 120/120 real win_probability values, cutoff-stamped, future_data_excluded=true.
models_inspected.classification: A -- faithful, already-production PRE model. Existing production model, not touched by this task.

models_inspected.method: Monte Carlo, anchored on each player's real, already-played round score(s)
models_inspected.status_for_kb: ARCHITECTURALLY INAPPLICABLE at PRE -- requires >=1 real played round as input; KB has not reached R1 (per this task's own PRE-only scope). Confirmed present, unmodified, on this HEAD (see content/website_v2/NEO_PROBABILITY_ENGINE_LINEAGE_RECOVERY_V1.json, generated by commit 4c0e8d7, independently re-verifiable by inspecting round_update.py's own signature).
models_inspected.classification: D -- disconnected from a PRE use case, not because it is invalid, but because it is the wrong stage. This is the historical production model for POST-round checkpoints; it is NOT a PRE model and this task does not attempt to force it into one.

models_inspected.stage: PRE (genuinely -- every round drawn from the frozen PRE prior, no real round ever used as an anchor)
models_inspected.method: Monte Carlo, i.i.d. per-round Normal(expected_round_score_to_par, spread) draws, empirical cut fraction applied after simulated Round 2
models_inspected.reused_components: expected_round_score_to_par / spread are the SAME two frozen PRE-time features round_update.py already uses for a player's REMAINING (not-yet-played) rounds -- never retuned, never given new weights. DISCLOSED_HISTORICAL_CUT_FRACTION (336/602) is reused verbatim from docs/SITE_STRUCTURE_TODO.md's own already-published made_cut split, not invented for this module.
models_inspected.novel_component: The specific act of drawing ALL FOUR rounds (including what would be Round 1) from the prior, with no real-round anchor at all -- this exact configuration never existed anywhere in this codebase before commit 4c0e8d7. It is architecturally the FIRST PRE-stage implementation of the five-tier tally, not a restoration of a prior PRE-stage model that was removed or disabled.
models_inspected.classification: B -- new experimental implementation. It faithfully reuses the historical engine's own already-validated feature definitions and constants (never invents a new skill signal), but the PRE-stage simulation structure itself is new, has never been in production, and has never been used to generate a publicly displayed prediction for any tournament, KB included. This must NOT be described as 'recovered' -- nothing PRE-stage was lost and restored; something new was built on top of already-existing, already-disclosed pieces.
models_inspected.publication_status_general: BLOCKED_INSUFFICIENT_SAMPLE (see content/website_v2/NEO_PRE_5PROB_PUBLICATION_GATE_V1.json, global_verdict) -- applies to the model itself, independent of any one tournament.
models_inspected.publication_status_kb_specific: BLOCKED_MISSING_RAW_FEATURES_IN_SANDBOX (see content/website_v2/KB_2026090003_PRE_5PROB_STATUS.json and this task's own KB_2026090003_PRE_FEATURE_COVERAGE_V1.json) -- KB's real field cannot even be fed into this model in this sandbox, a second, independently-stacking block.

real_pre_model_path_conclusion.for_WIN_alone: M4 -- already legitimate, already run for KB, production-approved.
real_pre_model_path_conclusion.for_CUT_TOP20_TOP10_TOP5: NEO_PRE_5PROB_V1 is the only PRE-stage implementation that architecturally exists for these tiers. It is NOT yet publication-approved for ANY tournament (insufficient historical validation) and additionally cannot be run for KB specifically (missing raw features in this sandbox). No other candidate model exists in this repository for these four tiers at the PRE stage.
real_pre_model_path_conclusion.no_faithful_reconstruction_claim_made: This task does not classify NEO_PRE_5PROB_V1 as option A ('faithful reconstruction of an existing NEO model'). It is option B, and is reported as such throughout every artifact this task produces.

simulation_count_note: No simulation was run for KB by this task (blocked at the input-feature stage before any simulation could legitimately begin) -- see KB_2026090003_PRE_PROBABILITY_SNAPSHOT_V1.json.
